title: Apply Table Heatmap (Tables)

scenarios.title: Apply Table Heatmap applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Apply Table Heatmap (BtnTableHeatmap) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnTableHeatmap deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the fixture 3x3 table\u0027s cells hold 10/30/50/20/40/Label/15/35/45; the entire-table heatmap run with color preset 0 (Red to Yellow to Green) in fill mode paints the minimum cell (1,1) the exact low red, the exact-midpoint cell (1,2) the exact midpoint yellow and the maximum cell (1,3) the exact high green, leaves the non-numeric pre-filled label cell (2,3) blue, keeps all texts and the table geometry, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the fixture 3x3 table's cells hold 10/30/50/20/40/Label/15/35/45; the entire-table heatmap run with color preset 0 (Red to Yellow to Green) in fill mode paints the minimum cell (1,1) the exact low red, the exact-midpoint cell (1,2) the exact midpoint yellow and the maximum cell (1,3) the exact high green, leaves the non-numeric pre-filled label cell (2,3) blue, keeps all texts and the table geometry, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
